title: PRISM/CY — Config
description: Landscape-level configuration for a PRISM/CY cybersecurity landscape. Lives at .prism-cy/config.yaml.

organization.description: Name of the organization this landscape describes.

description.description: Short description of the landscape scope and context.

domain.description: Industry or business domain (e.g., insurance, healthcare, finance).

temporal_state.description: Overall temporal state of this landscape snapshot.

as_of.description: The date this landscape accurately reflected the security posture.

active_dimensions.description: Which PRISM/CY dimensions are in use for this landscape.

security_frameworks.description: Compliance and security frameworks applicable to this landscape.

transition_programs.description: Active security remediation or migration programs running across this landscape.

author.description: Author or owner of this landscape.

contact.description: Contact email or handle for questions about this landscape.

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this landscape was first created.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 date of the last modification.

reviewed_by.description: Name or handle of last reviewer.

review_date.description: ISO 8601 date of last formal review.
